audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and mid both said Level 6 flips to Garen because 'Q silence cancels her Leap of Faith (R)' and Demacian Justice executes her through it.
audit.why: Leap of Faith carries the untargetable flag — Illaoi cannot be targeted during it, so Demacian Justice, a single-target cast, has no target at all. Telling the player to spend a 120-second ultimate into her ultimate is the exact opposite of the right play; the counterplay is to wait it out. Nothing in Riot's text supports a silence cancelling an ult already cast, and Decisive Strike is an 8s spell used at 300 range against a 450-range slam.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as Illaoi's window, with 'hold R until the slam ends' replacing the cancel claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven stages disagreed with the packet, and three of them disagreed with the page's own why-text: win[2] said Skill where whys[2] says 'remains yours', win[3] said Skill where whys[3] says 'favour Illaoi', win[5] said Skill where whys[5] says 'is yours'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Garen/Garen/Garen/Illaoi/Illaoi/Garen/Skill at 54.88% over 2482 games. Every stage where prose and packet agreed, the token was the odd one out. The only genuine conflict was Level 6, and there the prose rested on the Leap of Faith error above, so the packet stands.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one group to Garen/Garen/Garen/Illaoi/Illaoi/Garen/Skill, with whys[4] rewritten so the prose matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown attached to any spike; report[5] gave Test of Spirit a flat 16s.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 — 16s only at rank 1 — and Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s, which is why she can re-engage between grabs. Those two numbers are the whole trade rhythm.
audit.corrected: Both written into report[5], dosFull[0].t and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tied Grievous Wounds to her tentacle healing, though the itemization block already buys Executioner's.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever a tentacle damages a champion, so in a tentacle field her sustain, not her burst, is what beats Garen's grind.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds attached to the tentacle heal in dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Common Mistakes said 'Stand in her W slam' with no tell attached.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up animation is the cue to step back, not the ability cast, which lands too late to react to.
audit.corrected: The auto-reset tell written into Common Mistakes.

notes: The packet's suspectNames flagged 'Land Test of Spirit' in wants.foe[0] — false positive, the name is correct; the flag is on the leading verb. The substantive fix is the Leap of Faith untargetability: the page told a Garen player to spend a 120s ultimate into the one window where she cannot be targeted. wants.you[0] ('Silence her R and E with Q') carries a softer version of the same claim but is under 25 characters of changed meaning and I could not rewrite it inside the length band without asserting a silence-timing interaction the kits do not document — left alone and flagged here.
